content_of_post_to_comment: Please don't quit your job and go "all in.” Find an hour each day to grow a small side project. Replace 60% to 70% of your current income while trending in the right direction. Then make your move. Almost always a better decision.
comment: The overlooked challenge is not just replacing income, but proving you can sustain the habits and systems behind the side project before removing the structure of a job.
